headlines.title: שר הביטחון כ"ץ מזהיר את חמאס: "אם ייחטף חייל או אזרח ישראלי - העיר עזה כולה תפונה"
headlines.snippet: Defense Minister K";"atz warned Hamas that if an Israeli soldier or citizen is abducted, the entire city of Gaza will be evacuated. Speaking at the state memorial ceremony for the Yom Kippur War fallen, Katz clarified that Israel will not retreat from its 'yellow line' in Gaza until Hamas is removed and the Strip is demilitarized. He also addressed the campaign against Iran, stating they eliminated Khamenei and removed the nuclear annihilation threat, emphasizing the work is not finished and they will strike a third time if necessary.

He argued that since the terror group has not been active there, there's no reason for violations, and that the Palestinian people's right to exist must be respected. headlines.snippet: Natanel Sharoni, who was murdered in a shooting attack near Neve Tzuf, was laid to rest. His 16-year-old son, Yoav, who was with him during the attack, bid him farewell, saying, "Thank you for giving me life." His wife, Merav, described him as the most involved father, and his sister, Ruti, remembered him as a pleasant, wise, and humble person.

headlines.title: נתנאל שקרון הוא הנרצח בפיגוע במעיין בבנימין; המחבל נלכד בבית חולים ברמאללה
headlines.snippet: Natanel Sharoni was murdered in an attack near a spring in Benjamin, and the perpetrator was apprehended in a Ramallah hospital. The attacker opened fire on people at the spring, then fled. Sharoni, a father of six from Ali Zahav, was critically injured and later died. Following a large manhunt, the perpetrator was arrested in a hospital after being wounded during the pursuit. Separately, a second attacker attempting a ramming attack in the northern West Bank was neutralized.
